dedupe_keys.name: global oil and gas plant tracker

description: The Global Oil and Gas Plant Tracker from Global Energy Monitor (GEM), a non-profit research organisation, is a worldwide data set of oil- and gas-fired power plants at unit level. On 26 September 2026 the page counted 16,559 units in 171 countries, more than 3,200 plant owners and 1,136 GW of oil and gas capacity in development. Records give location, capacity, technology, status, owner and parent, and start and planned retirement years, and each plant links to a GEM.wiki page with sources. Summary tables cover status changes, coal-to-gas conversions, captive plants by industry and capital expenditure. Data are updated twice a year, around January and July; the latest release was August 2026. Coverage is global. Access is through a free online tracker map, dashboards and summary tables, and the full data set is a spreadsheet downloadable through a short download form on GEM's site, under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: small units may be missing, and plans for projects in development change often. Simulation uses are generation fleet inputs for power system models, gas demand from power estimates and hazard exposure of thermal plants. Related records: data-gem-global-integrated-power-tracker combines GEM's power trackers and data-gem-global-energy-ownership-tracker maps owners.
